t: You're standing where Advision Studios once stood. It was a recording studio in Fitzrovia, and it began life at 83 New Bond Street. It has gone now, so there's little to see of it. It was founded by Stephen Appleby, who lived from 1912 to 1984. He was a British test pilot, and a leading champion of the Mignet Pou-du-Ciel, the little aircraft known as the Flying Flea. A pilot who founded a studio is an unusual combination.
